sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 7 December 2024, pitch SYN-SYNCP000113-P1 was put before Riverbend Physician Alliance 113 on behalf of MERCK & COMPANY.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 2.75 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a HPV preferred-position minimum of 75 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
